variants.name: Tracerless
variants.info:
Ammo that doesn't have the components that create weapon tracers.

Greater overall accuracy for less range performance and bullet penetration.

variants.name: 12.7x55mm LP
variants.info: Swaps your ammunition to 12.7x55mm LP supersonic ammo: a lightweight bullet that increases your muzzle velocity significantly while reducing damage. Comes with a 20-round extended magazine for more traditional battle rifle performance.

variants.name: 12.7x55mm DP
variants.info: Swaps your ammunition load to a duplex bullet! Fires two smaller, weaker projectiles that hit hard up close, but lose out on damage and accuracy at range.

variants.name: 12.7x55mm BP
variants.info: Load your ShAK-12 with 12.7x55mm BP armor piercing rounds: giving it significantly increased penetration and performance to the torso, but reduced performance to the head.
